plugins.name: claude-plugin
plugins.description: Turn Reo into your GTM copilot inside Claude. Research accounts and buyers, prioritize your daily account list by ICP fit and real activity, and surface deanonymized engaged developers — all grounded in ~90M enriched LinkedIn profiles, firmographic data, hiring signals, and first-party engagement from the Reo buyer intelligence platform.

skills.name: account-research-v2
skills.description: Generate a comprehensive, visual account research dashboard for any company using the fast reo_get_account_research composite endpoint. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "research an account", "pull up account intel", "get me a brief on [company]", "show me what's going on at [company]", "run account research", or anything similar. Also trigger this skill when the user mentions a company name or domain and wants sales context, buyer intel, hiring signals, engagement activity, or contact information. Even vague prompts like "what do we know about [company]?" or "prep me for my call with [company]" should trigger this skill. Output is always a dark-mode HTML dashboard rendered inline.
skills.description_zh: 通过 reo_get_account_research 复合端点生成公司的可视化客户研究报告，汇总销售背景、买方情报、招聘信号、互动活动和联系人资料，适用于公司简报与客户通话准备；输出内联显示的深色 HTML 仪表盘。

skills.name: daily-account-prioritizer-v2
skills.description:
Generates a holistic, scored, SDR/AE-ready list of accounts to focus on today —
combining ICP fit, dev funnel stage, activity score, and recency momentum signals
from reo, with territory and CRM stage acting as hard filters. Uses the fast
reo_get_daily_focus_list composite endpoint — a single API call that returns
pre-scored, pre-ranked, pre-enriched accounts. Use this skill whenever someone
asks: "what accounts should I focus on today?", "give me my daily account list",
"who should I call today?", "prioritize my accounts", "show me my hot list",
"rank accounts by fit", "build my SDR list", "score my accounts", or any request
for a ranked or scored account list. Always trigger this skill for daily pipeline
triage workflows.
headings: Step 1 — Fetch the Focus List (single call)
"Why it's here" — one concrete sentence per account
"Recommended action" — one prescriptive line per account
skills.description_zh: 利用 reo_get_daily_focus_list 一次获取已评分、排序和补充资料的客户，结合理想客户匹配度、开发者漏斗阶段、活动分数及近期动量，按区域和 CRM 阶段严格筛选，生成 SDR 或客户经理当天应重点跟进的客户清单。

skills.name: engineering-org-chart
skills.description:
Builds a visual, top-to-bottom engineering org chart for any target account using reo open data (LinkedIn profiles) with reo activity signals overlaid on every node. Shows the full engineering hierarchy — CTO/VP Eng → Directors → Managers → Senior ICs → ICs — grouped by sub-team (Platform, Data/ML, Backend, Frontend, DevOps/SRE, Security). Signal-active employees are highlighted green; stale signals are amber; no signals are grey. Output is always an interactive HTML tree diagram rendered inline via show_widget.
Use this skill whenever the user asks for: "engineering org chart for [company]", "map the eng team at [company]", "show me the engineering hierarchy at [company]", "who leads engineering at [company]", "top to bottom eng team for [company]", "who are the engineers at [company]", "build me an org chart", or any request to visualise, map, or understand the engineering structure at a named account. Also trigger when researching a company's engineering team size, leadership, or sub-team breakdown.
headings: Node is GREEN 🟢 if they have an activity signal within this many days.
Node is AMBER 🟡 if a signal exists but is older than SIGNAL_ACTIVE_DAYS.
Node is GREY ⚫ if no signals at all.
4a. Hierarchy Level — use reo `seniority` field directly
Build signal map: prospect id → signal status
Step 6 — Render the HTML Org Chart (show_widget)
Layout — Two View Modes with Toggle
skills.description_zh: 利用 reo 公开 LinkedIn 资料构建目标公司的工程组织树，按 CTO、主管、经理及个人贡献者层级和平台、数据、前后端、运维及安全等子团队分组；叠加活动信号，以绿、黄、灰区分活跃、过期及无信号人员，输出交互式 HTML。

skills.name: sales-call-prep
skills.description: Preps customer meetings for a sales rep — fetches events from Google Calendar (today, a specific day, or the whole week) and generates a structured brief for each meeting using the reo-gateway MCP. Each brief combines per-meeting account intel (engagement, signals, hiring, prospects) with per-attendee intel matched by email and name. Supersedes the older call-prep-sheet and weekly-meeting-digest skills that were built on the legacy reo MCP. Trigger this skill whenever the user asks to "prep my calls", "prep today", "prep my week", "what's on my calendar", "get me ready for my meetings", "prep [company] call", "Monday briefing", "call prep", or any phrasing that implies "help me get ready for the customer meetings on my calendar". Also trigger when the user references a specific meeting they have coming up and wants background on it.
headings: CONFIG — edit the values here to customise the skill
1. Edit only the value to the right of the colon.
2. Do not rename parameters — the skill reads them by name.
3. Save the file. Changes apply on the next run.
Add your company's email domain(s) to INTERNAL_DOMAINS so internal-only
meetings are skipped. Any meeting where every attendee is on an internal
domain is dropped from the brief.
What to do when the user doesn't specify a time range.
"ask"        → ask the user (today vs whole week) before fetching the calendar
skills.description_zh: 读取 Google Calendar 中当天、指定日期或整周客户会议，通过 reo-gateway MCP 为每场生成结构化准备简报，结合客户互动、招聘和潜在客户信号，以及按邮箱与姓名匹配的参会者情报；原说明称其取代旧版通话准备与周会议摘要技能。
